title: Whistleblower
one_paragraph_synopsis: In this episode, Michael and the office grapple with a leak about Sabre printers, leading to accusations, confessions, and discussions about handling the situation and the potential whistleblower. Personal issues and office conflicts intertwine as characters navigate the fallout of the leak and their relationships.
